title: Spatial self-organization of enzymes in complex reaction networks
authors: Vincent Ouazan-Reboul; Ramin Golestanian; Jaime Agudo-Canalejo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酶在复杂反应网络中的趋化性驱动的空间自组织，类比生物分子凝聚体形成，但对象为折叠酶而非无序蛋白/IDR，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅理论建模，对IDP介导PPI机制建模有间接启发。
abstract: Living systems contain intricate biochemical networks whose structure is closely related to their function and allows them to exhibit robust behavior in the presence of external stimuli. Such networks typically involve catalytic enzymes, which can have non-trivial transport properties, in particular chemotaxis-like directed motion along gradients of substrates and products. Here, we find that taking into account enzyme chemotaxis in models of catalyzed reaction networks can lead to their spatial self-organization in a process similar to biomolecular condensate formation. We develop a general theory for arbitrary reaction networks, and systematically study all closed unimolecular reaction networks involving up to six chemicals. Importantly, we find that network-wide propagation of concentration perturbations can be key to enabling self-organization. The ability to self-organize is highly dependent on the relative signs of the chemotactic mobilities of the enzymes to their substrate and product and on the global network structure. We find that spontaneous self-organization through chemotaxis can provide an avenue for the self-regulation of metabolic activity in complex catalyzed reaction networks. The network-induced interaction mechanism we uncover operates in the regime where the substrate molecules are diffusion-limited, suggesting that signaling molecules could take advantage of this scenario towards their functionality.
abstract_zh: 生命系统包含复杂的生化网络，其结构与功能密切相关，并使其在外部刺激存在时表现出稳健行为。此类网络通常涉及催化酶，这些酶可能具有非平凡的传输特性，特别是沿底物和产物梯度的趋化样定向运动。在此，我们发现，在催化反应网络模型中考虑酶趋化性可导致其空间自组织，这一过程类似于生物分子凝聚体形成。我们为任意反应网络发展了一个通用理论，并系统研究了涉及最多六种化学物质的所有封闭单分子反应网络。重要的是，我们发现网络范围内的浓度扰动传播可能是实现自组织关键。自组织能力高度依赖于酶对其底物和产物的趋化迁移率的相对符号以及整体网络结构。我们发现，通过趋化性实现的自发自组织可为复杂催化反应网络中代谢活性的自我调节提供途径。我们揭示的网络诱导相互作用机制在底物分子受扩散限制的范围内运作，这表明信号分子可能利用这一场景来实现其功能。
